tool.name: UFCG tree
tool.description: Reconstruct the phylogenetic relationship with UFCG profiles
tool.command:
mkdir input_dir && mkdir temp_dir && mkdir output_dir && #import re #for $input_file in $input_directory #set $identifier = re.sub('[^\w\-_\.]', '_', $input_file.element_identifier) ln -s $input_file 'input_dir/$(identifier).ucg' && #end for
ufcg tree -i input_dir -o temp_dir -t \${GALAXY_SLOTS:-4} -l $tree_leaf_format -a $alignment_method -c $align_multiple_gene -f $gap_rich_filter -g $gsi_threshold 2>&1 | tee ufcg_full.log && mv temp_dir/tree output_dir/ && mv temp_dir/align output_dir/ && mv temp_dir/misc output_dir/ && mv temp_dir/aligned_concatenated.fasta output_dir/ && mv temp_dir/concatenated_gsi_55.nwk output_dir/ && mv temp_dir/concatenated.nwk output_dir/ && mv temp_dir/tree.ckp output_dir/ && mv temp_dir/tree.log output_dir/ && mv temp_dir/tree.trm output_dir/ && cat ufcg_full.log | tail > "$log_file"

param.name: input_directory
param.label: Input directory
param.help: Directory containing fungal genome assemblies (ufcg format)

param.name: tree_leaf_format
param.label: Select Tree Leaf format
param.help: Multiple options can be selected. default: label

param.name: gsi_threshold
param.label: Gene Support Index
param.help: Measures the number of individual gene trees that support a specific branch in a concatenated species tree

tool.help:
**UFCG Tree Tool**
Reconstruct the phylogenetic relationship with UFCG profiles from fungal genome assemblies using the UFCG (Universal Fungal Core Genes) pipeline.
**Input** - Input directory containing fungal genome assemblies in UCG format generated by ufcg profile
The options are::
-a, Select sequence to align - nucleotide : Use given nucleotide sequence (default) - protein : Use given amino acid sequence - codon : Use codons encrypting given amino acid sequence - codon12 : Use codons without third bases -l, Tree leaf format, comma-separated string containing one or more of the following keywords - uid - acc - label - taxon - strain - type - taxonomy -c, Align multiple copied gene (default : 0) -f, Gap-rich filter percentage threshold (0 - 100) [50] -g, GSI value threshold (1 - 100 ) [95]
**Output**
.. list-table:: :widths: 10 30 60 :header-rows: 1
* - Type - Name - Description * - Tree - concatenated.nwk - UFCG tree inferred from concatenated alignment * - - concatenated_gsi_[N].nwk - UFCG tree with GSI values computed with [N] genes, replacing bootstrap values * - - tree/[GENE].nwk - Gene tree inferred from each single gene * - Align - aligned_concatenated.fasta - Concatenated sequences of entire core gene alignments * - - align/aligned_[GENE].fasta - Aligned sequences of each single gene * - Misc - [run_id].log - Log file containing information about this run * - - [run_id].trm - JSON file containing entire trees and their metadata
**Citation** If you use UFCG in your research, please cite the appropriate publications.
